name: Telecanor Global Limited
about: Telecanor Global Limited provides technology for blockchain solutions, payment gateways, and related services in India. It offers blockchain as-a-service platform solutions; SMS, Interactive Voice Response (IVR), voice recognition, outbound calls, call center, and POS services; internet-based payment gateway; Prozeal, a platform that allows the operators to extract revenue from their existing base; and Keen Bank, a core banking software. The company also provides telecom solutions, including plug and play, multi-tier component architecture, fast customization, and IVR cum dialer services; and ERP solutions to integrate applications and systems. In addition, it offers various mobile solutions, including white labeled native/WAP based mobile applications, In-app mobile advertising solutions, customized mobile commerce applications, In-app payment acceptance solutions, and pre-paid solutions for mobile based micro payments. Further, the company provides consulting services. Telecanor Global Limited was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Hyderabad, India.
